# Wanago.io

> > JavaScript and TypeScript web development tutorials covering NestJS, Express, React, TypeORM, and modern backend architecture by Marcin Wanago.

Wanago.io is a comprehensive technical blog featuring in-depth tutorial series on building APIs with NestJS and Express, database integration with TypeORM/Prisma/Drizzle, authentication patterns, testing strategies, and full-stack JavaScript development. The site also offers private online courses for JavaScript and TypeScript developers.

## Key Topics

- NestJS
- TypeScript
- Express
- TypeORM
- PostgreSQL
- React
- API Development
- JavaScript Testing
- Database Relationships
- JWT Authentication
- Prisma ORM
- Drizzle ORM
- MongoDB & Mongoose
- Web Scraping
- Server-Side Rendering

## Getting Started

- [Homepage](https://wanago.io): JavaScript blog covering NestJS, Express, TypeScript, and more
- [Teaching & Private Courses](https://wanago.io/teaching): Private lessons for frontend/backend JavaScript and TypeScript
- [Dev Portal](https://dev.wanago.io): NestJS tutorials with PostgreSQL, Kysely, and Prisma

## NestJS API Development

- [Introduction to Drizzle ORM with PostgreSQL](https://wanago.io/2024/05/20/api-nestjs-drizzle-orm-postgresql): Setup NestJS with Drizzle ORM: CRUD operations and SQL migrations
- [Many-to-many relationships with Drizzle ORM](https://wanago.io/2024/06/24/api-nestjs-many-to-many-drizzle-postgresql): Implement many-to-many relationships using NestJS, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL
- [What's new in Express 5?](https://wanago.io/2025/02/10/api-nestjs-express-5): Express 5 changes and their impact on NestJS projects explained
- [Integration tests with Prisma](https://dev.wanago.io/2023/04/10/api-nestjs-prisma-integration-tests): Writing integration tests for NestJS APIs using Prisma ORM

## TypeScript Express Tutorial Series

- [TypeScript Express Tutorial Archives](https://wanago.io/courses/typescript-express-tutorial): TypeScript Express series: RESTful API with MongoDB and JWT auth
- [MongoDB relationships between documents](https://wanago.io/2018/12/31/mongodb-relationships-documents-typescript-express-tutorial-5): MongoDB document relationships in TypeScript Express with Mongoose
- [TypeORM Migrations with Postgres](https://wanago.io/2019/01/28/typeorm-migrations-postgres): TypeORM migrations with PostgreSQL: CLI and auto-generation guide
- [Code optimization with Mongoose Lean Queries](https://wanago.io/2020/04/20/typescript-express-tutorial-code-optimization-mongoose-lean): Optimize MongoDB queries with Mongoose Lean for better performance

## Database & ORM Guides

- [Database normalization with TypeORM and PostgreSQL](https://dev.wanago.io/2021/11/22/database-normalization-typeorm-postgresql): Database normalization explained with TypeORM and PostgreSQL examples

- [React SSR with Next.js (Dev Portal)](https://dev.wanago.io/2019/05/27/react-ssr-with-next-js-concept-of-server-side-rendering-routing): Next.js SSR fundamentals: routing, SEO benefits, isomorphic apps

## Web Scraping & Tooling
